quest.title: It's What He Deserves
quest.description: Evidence from Avice suggests that the Beret Society's leader, Dougier, has been using extremely cruel methods to control its members. No one could sit there and watch such evil deeds unfold.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x700, Primogem x60, Mora x49200, Guide to Order x5, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x11

chapter.title: Reborn in the Land of Grievances

talks.objective: Go to the Beret Society's gathering place

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: Your Grace, we've taken the society members into custody.

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: They all tried to flee just a little while ago, as if they had received some kind of order.

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: We decided to act to forestall their plan, and were just about to send the word when you unexpectedly arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Great work, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You had prepared for something like this all along?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I had them stay here to keep an eye on things, so I'm glad that my intuition turned out to be correct.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Perform a thorough search of the Society's headquarters, and bring all the members to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: Understood, Your Grace.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Now, let's check on them...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: As expected, they all have a hollow thorn inserted into a wound on their head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's glad her eyesight isn't so good that she could see it from here... Paimon's gonna float away for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They didn't pull the thorn out?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: They probably left it there as a lasting reminder of Dougier's "censure."

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: ...These people must have had to endure an unimaginable amount of pain.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let's go check out the other areas, too.

talks.objective: Look for clues in this area

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Look at what I found.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This is a surveillance port. With this, Dougier would be able to remotely monitor everything that's happening at the gathering place.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: So even if Dougier's not there in person, he'll still always have eyes on the members.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That'd explain why they were all so terrified.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Indeed. It's easy to become lost and confused when you're given no instructions, or any kind of script to follow.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: And if any action you take may be deemed a mistake, then perhaps it's better to do less, or to not do anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Dougier has already tamed them to his will.

talks.objective: Look for clues in this area

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a book that Paimon found in a box next to the bookshelf. Its contents are exactly the same as this book on the shelf.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The colors of their covers are completely different, though, and the names of the authors also don't match up...

choices.text: So these were also just for show...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, and they dared to claim that they wrote these, too! Hmph!

choices.text: To make it look like the bookshelf's being added to and maintained...

talks.objective: Look for clues in this area

dialogues.speaker: Observe Papers
dialogues.text: (These papers are actually outdated, but they look brand new. It seems like no one has ever flipped through them.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Papers
dialogues.text: (If you look closely, even the creases are almost identical. They don't seem to have been formed naturally through reading...)

talks.objective: Look for clues in this area

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: Your Grace, Your Grace!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: We couldn't find any Society members in the other areas. It also seems like none of the equipment in those rooms were ever used — all the signs of wear and tear are fake.

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: The limescale, the layers of dust... they were all deliberately added.

dialogues.speaker: Ielmini
dialogues.text: We also investigated the members' residences, and weren't able to find anything. Their neighbors all say that they haven't returned home for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh... Is that right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're gone? That could only mean...

choices.text: The Society put a lot of effort into building a front.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Indeed. As long as he allowed Society members to mingle with others, even with threats of censure, Dougier knew that he could not stop all of his members from speaking out.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Meanwhile, this marvelous "gathering place" will lose all of its value as soon as a whistleblower sounds the alarm.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So instead of being his real base, this is just an elaborate performance. The rest areas, the fancy equipment, even the members that we saw... they were merely a part of the front.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And only the most docile and well-trained members were selected as his "performers."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But then... where can we actually find him?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Let me think...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Dougier must be holding all the rest of his members in another place. And if the overseer of my Fortress Guard has never alerted me to anything of the sort...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: He must be in Dougier's pocket.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm of the same mind. Let's go. You too, follow me.

choices.text: He can tell us where the real headquarters are.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did that person flee here?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That's the most likely scenario to me. He's probably already caught wind of Dougier's declaration of war against me, and has fled to seek his protection.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let's keep heading down. There are some abandoned areas in there. Since he needs space, I'd guess Dougier probably converted them into his headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: We should be on the right track. Now, we just need to find that turncoat.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let's go. We can take this path, you guys take the other.

talks.objective: Investigate the production zone with Wriothesley
Go after the Beret Society members that escaped

dialogues.speaker: Wyler
dialogues.text: Those blasted guards!

dialogues.speaker: Gouzien
dialogues.text: *panting*... *panting*...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Did Dougier send you? Why did you attack that guard?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, it's time to talk! Can't you see that he's trying to help!?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I will take your cooperation into consideration when it comes time to hand out sentences.

dialogues.speaker: Wyler
dialogues.text: Mr. Dougier, h—he... didn't want this guy to expose our true location...

dialogues.speaker: Wyler
dialogues.text: We were just about to dispose of him when you caught up to us.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: So, in other words, your headquarters should be this way?

dialogues.speaker: Gouzien
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, it's just down this way. You'll make it there once you've seen and passed through a large drainage pipe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now that's more like it.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Guards, take them away.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let's go. It's about time that we find out what Dougier's really after.

talks.objective: Talk to the Beret Society members you captured
Go to the Beret Society's real headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's so much space down here...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Yeah, these are all former work areas. They've been left abandoned due to a lack of funds.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: There are usually guards on patrol here... *sigh* It would seem that all of those guards have been bought as well.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Stay sharp. He's got a ton of surprises waiting for us, I'm sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You're safe now. Just follow the guards and leave this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knew that there'd be Gardemeks here... Dougier really prepared for everything.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That would explain the strange decommission requests I received, as well as account for all the Gardemeks that had mysteriously gone missing.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Seems like he's prepared for an all-out confrontation with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what's this?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Seems like some kind of handbook. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, this should be the Society's real rulesbook. It lists all the rules that they are expected to follow...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Members are not permitted to speak to each other, or to leave without formal permission...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Five members shall form a group, and the whole group will be punished for any single member's wrongdoings...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Anyone who reports a fellow member's misbehavior shall be rewarded with food and water.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: ...I see, so it's much as I expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that's just cruel and unreasonable...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: To obtain food and water, prisoners are forced to snitch on others, and in the process, cause pain to those around them.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: To avoid punishment, they learn to stop talking with one another. This leaves the wounds they've already received to fester, however, and so resentment builds, until every prisoner has become an island.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Finally, isolated and without hope, they accept their fate as Dougier's slaves.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Do you remember what happened to Paimon? She rejected all the snacks in the box once she was spooked by that black gem.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: She's usually all for tasty snacks, but she chose to go against her instincts after a negative experience.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, is that the best example you could come up with? Anyway, Paimon still thinks she made the right decision. It never hurts to be careful...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: No, your decision was valid. However, it's also valid to interpret that as a decision that you only made under emotional duress.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The human heart is like a raft in a vast and empty ocean. We convince ourselves that we're in control, but in truth, a single wave could sweep us off course, and send us crashing into the path of a storm.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Those who use fear to lead others astray must pay for that crime.

choices.text: The whole thing is an affront to human dignity.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, the space ahead should be the central area of this place, but the door's been locked.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Rather than confront Dougier, I think it's more important right now for us to rescue as many Society members as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You guys should wait here. We'll try to open the door and check out some other spots.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Open the door... Would we have to do something to this mechanism here? Ugh, Paimon doesn't get it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget it, Paimon's just gonna do some trial and error.

talks.objective: Operate the device in front of you

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: These should be the prison cells.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Hmm... Lots of empty cells in here. Dougier's probably moved them elsewhere already.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's still rescue the ones who got left behind, though. Every person counts!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's alright now! You can leave this place!

dialogues.speaker: Eclancher
dialogues.text: No... No! I won't try to leave anymore. I'll never try to leave again!

dialogues.speaker: Eclancher
dialogues.text: Don't get close to me. I don't want any trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, we're not gonna do that. Please calm down, we're not bad people!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: We won't be able to get through to her right now. Not with the stress response in the way.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'd also guess there are many others here who are more or less like her. Let's let the guards take care of them for now, and keep pushing forward.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Avice and Faissolle are still in danger.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Alright. Let's search for an exit first.

talks.objective: Try opening the door in front of you

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I leave this area to you. Make sure to bring everyone out safe.

dialogues.speaker: Secaille
dialogues.text: Understood, and please take care as well, Your Grace. We'll return here right away and await your orders.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, just focus on the tasks you've been given. I already have reliable help over here.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Let's go back. We have unfinished business, do we not?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That mechanism from the first room... Maybe we'll also need to hold it in place using the same device to open the door that leads to the central area.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Don't forget to bring these along.

talks.objective: Return to the center room and try opening the new door

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: I must confess to being furious. To think that there are still some of you who find it permissible to spit upon our rules.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Remember their names: Faissolle and Avice. They've betrayed you — betrayed us!

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: And today, you will see with your own eyes what will happen to those who betray our cause!

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Go on, Avice. Pierce his skull with the thorn in your hands, and then push in the Aqua Doloris.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Of course, you will do it one drop at a time. Let it do its magic again and again, and don't stop until you've pushed all of it in!

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Faissolle... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Faissolle
dialogues.text: It... It's okay. I'll... find a way to endure...

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Oh, shut your wretched mouths. When did I give you permission to speak!?

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: My rules are the paramount law of this place. Only more pain will come to those who dare to disobey!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: That's enough, Dougier. Your rabid screams have been beyond nauseating.

dialogues.speaker: Fidelin
dialogues.text: Is that... His Grace!?

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Ah, Wriothesley... I knew you would come, but I didn't expect you to be so quick.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Must you still refuse to let me be? Did I not spell everything out for you already? What's so blasphemous about sharing a slice of the cake with me when you've already got the entire fortress at your feet?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It would seem that you can't see the difference between "sharing" and "looting," and on top of that...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Look at your people. Are they not starving as you wolf down your cake?

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: You...! Stop acting all high and mighty like some hero of justice!

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Have you forgotten? Nobody in this blasted Fortress is innocent! We are all irredeemable monsters who have destroyed something that others held dear.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: What's so wrong about punishing those who deserve to be punished? It's what they've always deserved!

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: And please, are you really going to tell me that you care about their lives and well-being when you just need a supply of labor to keep this place running? Isn't that all you need to keep your cushy life?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sadly, you're wrong on both counts. Unlike you, I've never seen them as currency.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The Fortress is not only a place for confinement, but also a place for rebirth.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Just as people are free to give in to the darkness within their hearts, they are also free to seek redemption and a new beginning. Our bodies have limits, but our spirits will always remain free.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: They may have made mistakes, but they are still human beings with people and things that they cherish...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: And most importantly, they should always retain the freedom to choose their own path once they've reflected on their past misdeeds!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But you... You're destroying their spirits with fear! Taking their freedom away, so that they will become slaves who'll never again feel or think!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: And you say that's what they've always deserved? You're nothing compared to them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He... He's really mad!

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: You think me arrogant, Wriothesley? Well, I think you're too young and naive. You understand nothing of the world.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Nobody actually sees this Fortress as any kind of just or wonderful place. See it for what it is — a dumping ground of pain and misery, irredeemable now, and irredeemable forever!

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: No prisoner will listen to you out of gratitude of their hearts. The whip is the only way to make them obey!

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Had you been just one step slower, I would have already taken control of all the Gardemeks in this place.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Your Vision gives you strength, but how long will it hold against these powerful constructs?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hmph, you talk big, but in the end, you know nothing outside of power and control. In that case... let me give you a small taste of what real power looks like.

choices.text: Honestly, he's been keeping it in until now.

talks.objective: Capture Dougier and save the victims

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The guards rescue the Society members who have been imprisoned at the true headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Wriothesley spends much time with each member, comforting them and extending his personal apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Following that, he makes arrangements for follow-up medical care and cleanup work.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: And thus does the Beret Society debacle truly come to an end.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sorry for taking so long. Did I keep you waiting?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, not at all! Paimon didn't know you were so considerate.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Heh, if you ask me, I'd say I actually feel very helpless. There's no way that I could truly empathize with the fear that the members felt every day.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I could comfort and compensate them all I want, but it might still not be enough to repair the damage that has been done.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I have to take responsibility for it, as does the Fortress.

choices.text: At least we were able to stop it before it got any worse, right?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yeah, it's the least that we could do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, do you have a plan for how you're gonna deal with him yet?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Oh, Dougier? I've already got an idea.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: For now, I think I'll do nothing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I think it's a very fitting punishment for him to have to imagine the sorts of punishments that will be soon coming his way.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: He'll be left in the dark with regards to both the dates and the details of his punishment.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, that's not to say that I'll be letting him off scot-free. It's not often that I actually get the chance to be creative with my punishments...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm going to talk to the members of the Society. He'll get a chance to experience everything that he's ever inflicted on them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't know you could also be so harsh... Looks like she should watch her tongue when she's around you in the future.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Why do you think I'd do that kind of thing to you? You offend me, Paimon.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Anyway, jokes aside, thank you so much for all of your help. There's still a lot for me to take care of, so...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: How about this? I'll treat you to a meal in two days at the Coupon Cafeteria. We should have a better handle on things by then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... No, Paimon's had enough of that place...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Don't worry, it won't be the same old Welfare Meal. I'll make the necessary arrangements.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, then you've got yourself a deal!

choices.text: I suppose this is a kind of punishment that only the Fortress can mete out.
Maybe you should give a more formal apology.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You're right. Besides formal apologies and reprimands, I also probably need to head upstairs to have a talk about how best to manage the guards.

choices.text: You sound more serious than usual.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Even I wouldn't be able to find humor in a situation like this.

talks.objective: Meet up with Wriothesley at the Coupon Cafeteria

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon never forgets about meals! Even if {NICKNAME} forgets, Paimon will remind {F#her}{M#him} for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You say that as if I haven't been feeding you or something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that's not what Paimon meant at all! Wriothesley, you got what Paimon meant, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Mm? I'm a little confused, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, not you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Jokes aside, I've got some good news. After taking a look, the doctors have let me know that it shouldn't be too difficult to extract the thorns.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Which means that everyone should be able to recover after a period of rest.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: As for their mental recoveries, most are making good progress as well. We've added a few who were more severely affected to a special observation list.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've sure got everything taken care of, Wriothesley!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I try my best. After all, it's my duty to take care of everything that happens within my territory.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have a question for you, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Please go ahead.

choices.text: Your flashbacks when you picked up the gem...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Ah, that's a bit of a long story...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I once had a similar experience. It had to do with the host family I lived with as a child...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I was an orphan adopted by a couple with a great deal of love in their hearts. I had many siblings, and we all adored each other.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Once we were older, Mom and Dad would turn us over to be individually adopted by families of greater means, and go on to adopt more young children...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: They were perfect parents — or so I thought.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then...?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And then I found out we were merely raised as livestock. Once we had reached a certain age, our "parents" would bring us to the market for sale.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: All children that were sold would leave the house, and nobody would know what became of them. As for those who didn't sell... they were merely "disposed of."

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Did you know? I once considered myself an extremely lucky child. And all of my friends — all of my siblings — they all felt this way as well...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I was also not the first to find out about the truth. All those who found out before me were simply added to the disposal pile.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I could never shake the feeling of irony every time I juxtaposed their tragic ends against our parents' adoring smiles.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That explains a lot...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yes, like the Society, my parents created a facade of joy, lied to satiate their desires, and even employed incredibly cruel methods to keep their grasp on power.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: They did all of that, but never considered how their actions would utterly ruin all the children they took under their wing. Worse, perhaps they never cared about that at all.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: —But I did.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, in the end, I killed them, and set all of the remaining children free. I was convicted for my crimes, and exiled to the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: My methods were extreme, yes...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But I was still a teenager at the time. I'd been betrayed by those I trusted most, and I didn't think that more "moderate" ways would solve the problem.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: My doubt and helpless anger pushed me forward until I got what I deserved.

choices.text: I have to... take some time to process that.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's alright, you don't have to tell me what you think. I've already committed to this path, regardless of what anyone may say about it.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The least I can do is to make sure that the same tragedy will not happen again in my new home.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: Sorry to disturb you, everyone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's Avice and Faissolle! Are you two feeling better yet?

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: It was all because you arrived in time. I managed to escape unscathed.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Glad to hear it.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: We came here on impulse today, because we were hoping that you'd be able to lend us a hand, Your Grace...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Please go on right ahead. I'll do my best to help — within reason, of course.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: It's... Erm... I'd like to be wedded to Avice here at the Fortress...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're getting married!?

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: Yeah, we met each other through the Society, and both fell into Dougier's trap.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: But even during our time there, we never doubted each other. We always believed that Dougier was manipulating us, trying to make us mistrust each other.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: And after this incident... We've come to believe that we've found "the one" for the rest of our lives.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: Hehe, you could say we managed to make the best out of a bad situation. He didn't abandon me, and I didn't forsake him either.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: But we're still both prisoners, and we also aren't sure if the Fortress is the best place to host something so celebratory...

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: So we are just wondering... Is our request a bit too out of line?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hmm, you're right in that the Fortress has never hosted a wedding before...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But that's no reason to say no, is it? I'll help you make the arrangements. If you need anything special shipped in from the surface, just say the word.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: We can't thank you enough, Your Grace!

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: We are actually also planning to stay here after the conclusion of our sentences.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: Yeah, we've already made tons of special memories here, so now, it'd be too hard to leave.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: And we have full confidence in the Fortress' future with you at the helm, Your Grace.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Your trust is the highest form of praise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, loosen up a bit. Shouldn't you be the happiest man in Teyvat to hear that people would like to stay of their own free will?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yeah...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'll always take a genuine expression of faith over any obligation to obey.

choices.text: I don't really know what to say.
Your anger when you confronted Dougier...

dialogues.speaker: Secaille
dialogues.text: The guards from the Fortress of Meropide have already taken control of this area. You're safe now.

dialogues.speaker: Eclancher
dialogues.text: *whimpers*

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: All this time, he's been treating them like animals.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This seems to be something like a console...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: This is a surveillance terminal. The information collected by the surveillance ports we found previously will be sent here.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'm sure Dougier really enjoyed sitting here and making his people dance like puppets on strings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Grrr... That makes Paimon even angrier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, come here! Have a look at this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's a fallen guard over there! Paimon sees some Society members, too!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: After them.

dialogues.speaker: Wyler
dialogues.text: It's Wriothesley! Run!

dialogues.speaker: Secaille
dialogues.text: Ah, the door's open! Maybe it's His Grace. I'll go take a look!
